Introduction

Matthew

Arnold

The English Poets

Selections with Critical Introductions by Various Writers

Edited by Thomas Humphry Ward

This first great classic poetry anthology in five volumes contains 1446 selections by over 200 authors and features lengthy critical introductions by fellow poets and literary critics.
